req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-015 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} with {"completed": true} sets completed=true and returns HTTP 2xx. I design: (1) a positive EP test that creates a task with completed=false then PUTs completed=true and asserts the exact response fields; (2) a negative NEG test that PUTs to a non-existent task_id and asserts HTTP 404 with exact detail; (3) a boundary STC test that verifies the state transition completed=true -> completed=false (round-trip), catching boolean-negation and assignment mutations; (4) a DT test that sends only the completed field (partial update) and asserts other fields are unchanged; (5) a BVA test that sends completed=false to a completed=true task, asserting the exact false value is stored, catching mutations that always set true.

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import sqlalchemy, app.database as _db, app.models as _m

_db.SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./test_ep_complete.db"
_db.engine = sqlalchemy.create_engine(_db.SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
_db.SessionLocal = sqlalchemy.orm.sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=_db.engine)
_m.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=_db.engine)
_m.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=_db.engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_mark_task_complete_positive():
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "ep task", "completed": False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()["id"]
    assert r_create.json()["completed"] == False

    r_put = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"completed": True})
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    body = r_put.json()
    assert body["completed"] == True
    assert body["id"] == task_id
    assert body["title"] == "ep task"

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import sqlalchemy, app.database as _db, app.models as _m

_db.SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./test_stc_complete.db"
_db.engine = sqlalchemy.create_engine(_db.SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
_db.SessionLocal = sqlalchemy.orm.sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=_db.engine)
_m.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=_db.engine)
_m.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=_db.engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_mark_complete_state_transition_true_to_false():
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "stc task", "completed": True})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()["id"]
    assert r_create.json()["completed"] == True

    r_put = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"completed": False})
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    body = r_put.json()
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert body["completed"] is not True
    assert body["id"] == task_id

    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    assert r_get.json()["completed"] == False
